sidesIncludedWith: Burgers come with one side: Fries, Onion Rings, Mac n Cheese, Salad

items.name: Chicken Wings
items.description: Crispy chicken wings tossed in one of our signature sauces, served with a side house-made ranch or bleu cheese
items.options: Buffalo · BBQ · Sweet Chili · Garlic Parmesan · Cajun Dry Rub

items.name: Hog Fries
items.description: Golden, crispy fries topped with melted cheese & bacon bites. A crave-worthy combo that hits the spot every time.

items.name: Mac Daddy Fries
items.description: Golden crispy fries layered with melted cheese, smothered with our homemade mac n' cheese, bacon crumbles & drizzled with our house-made burger sauce.

items.name: Hot Daddy Fries
items.description: Crispy golden fries smothered in creamy mac & cheese, drizzled with our house-made burger sauce, and finished with a dusting of fiery Hot Cheeto crumble for the perfect crunch and kick.

items.name: Cowboy Candy
items.description: Fresh sliced jalapeños hand-dipped in beer batter and fried golden brown, served with a side of ranch for the perfect crunch.

items.name: Classic Quesadilla
items.description: A golden, crispy tortilla folded and grilled to perfection, stuffed with a melty blend of cheeses. Pared with our house made jalapeño ranch & pickled onions.
items.options: Add protein of choice for $5 — Chicken, Pulled Pork, Tri-Tip or Brisket

sections.name: Meat Combos
sections.note: Available until sold out. Choose your meats and sides.

items.name: One Meat Combo
items.description: Select one meat & choice of one side, complemented with garlic bread or corn bread.
items.options: Meats: Tri-Tip · Chicken · Brisket · Pork Ribs · Pulled Pork

items.name: Two Meat Combo
items.description: Select two meats & choice of one side, complemented with garlic bread or corn bread.
items.options: Sides: Fries · Barrel Beans · Salad · Beer Battered Onion Rings · Homemade Mac n' Cheese

items.name: Three Meat Combo
items.description: Select three meats & choice of two sides, complemented with garlic bread or corn bread.

sections.name: Rustic Favorites
sections.note: Burgers come with one side: Fries, Onion Rings, Mac n Cheese, Salad

items.name: O.G. Smash Burger
items.description: A mouth watering Angus beef patty, smashed & seared to perfection, American cheese, house-made burger sauce & grilled onions, served on a brioche bun.

items.name: Smash Burger Deluxe
items.description: A juicy, smashed beef patty, layered with American cheese, mayo, crisp lettuce, fresh sliced tomatoes, and thin-cut onions, all stacked on a toasted brioche bun.

items.name: Rustic Burger
items.description: Sink your teeth into two grilled Angus beef patties, layered with American cheese, grilled onions, topped with juicy bacon crumble, 2 golden crispy onion rings & drizzled with BBQ sauce.

items.name: Barrel Fries
items.description: Golden crisscut fries, layered with cheese, choice of meat, drizzled with our house-made burger sauce, BBQ sauce & topped with coleslaw and pickled onions.
items.options: Meat choices: Tri-Tip, Chicken, Pulled Pork

items.name: Loaded Barrel Fries
items.description: Golden crisscut fries, layered with cheese, choice of meat, drizzled with our house-made burger sauce, BBQ sauce & topped with homemade mac n' cheese, coleslaw and pickled onions.

sections.name: Rustic Sandwiches
sections.note: All sandwiches served with one side: fries, onion rings, mac n' cheese, salad

items.name: Tri-Tip Sandwich
items.description: Tender sliced Santa Maria Style Tri-Tip, drizzled with BBQ sauce and served on a ciabatta bun toasted with butter.

items.name: Pulled Pork Sandwich
items.description: Slow smoked tender pulled pork, drizzled with BBQ sauce, piled high on ciabatta bun topped with coleslaw.

items.name: BBQ Chicken Sandwich
items.description: Juicy seasoned chicken bbq'd over Santa Maria grill, pulled off the bone and piled high on a toasted ciabatta bun, topped with BBQ sauce and coleslaw.

items.name: Chopped Brisket Sandwich
items.description: Our slow-smoked chopped brisket piled high on a toasted ciabatta bun, dripping with BBQ sauce and topped with crunchy coleslaw for the perfect bite.

items.name: Chimi Tri-Tip Sandwich
items.description: Tender sliced tri-tip stacked on a toasted ciabatta bun with savory grilled onions and fresh house-made chimichurri. Packed with smoky flavor, garlic, and herbs in every juicy bite.

items.name: Grilled Cheese Combo
items.description: Toasty ciabatta bread filled with melty American cheese.
items.options: Add protein of choice for $5 — Chicken, Pulled Pork, Tri-Tip or Brisket

sections.name: Fresh Greens
sections.note: Dressing options: Ranch, Italian, Blue Cheese, House Sauce

items.name: Fresh Chopped Salad
items.description: Crispy chopped Romaine lettuce with your choice of meat (Tri-Tip, Chicken, Pulled Pork or Brisket) served with shredded cheese, croutons, cucumbers, tomatoes, topped with pickled onions, a side of pepperoncini.

items.name: Garden Wrap
items.description: Crisp chopped romaine, shredded cheese, tomatoes, cucumbers, all wrapped in a soft flour tortilla. Paired with your choice of dressing.

sections.name: Little Barrels
sections.note: Each meal includes one drink and one side: French fries, onion rings, mac n' cheese, side salad

items.name: Lil' Smash Burger
items.description: A tasty grilled Angus beef patty topped with melty cheese and burger sauce served on a soft bun.

items.name: Lil' Grilled Cheese
items.description: Toasty ciabatta bread filled with melty American cheese. Served warm and golden — perfect for little cheese lovers!

Smash Burger, Smash Burger Deluxe, Rustic Burger and Barrel Fries.

The Rustic Barrel menu page two: Rustic Sandwiches including Tri-Tip, Pulled Pork, BBQ Chicken and Chopped Brisket; Fresh Greens salads and Garden Wrap; Little Barrels kids meals; Freestyle Pick sides; and Cold Beverages.
